source: Research table in docs/tasks/completed/task-15-dictionary-api-shortlist-and-cost.md. docsUrl values are from memory and were not fetched (task-15 forbids network).

registrationHelp.reason: Manual approval — apply in advance; no free access stated.

providers.name: Free Dictionary API (dictionaryapi.dev)
providers.description: Volunteer-run, keyless JSON API built on Wiktionary data, with phonetics and sometimes UK/US audio links.
providers.note: Audio files are named *_gb_* / *_us_* and exist only for some words. Returned HTTP 522 on all ten words across two attempts on 2026-09-24 (host timing out).

providers.name: Merriam-Webster Dictionary API
providers.description: Merriam-Webster's Collegiate/Learner's dictionaries as JSON, with American pronunciation audio.

providers.name: Oxford Dictionaries API
providers.description: Oxford Languages' dictionary data with multiple senses and British-led pronunciation audio.
providers.note: Plans: Lite / Growing / Enterprise. Lite and Growing prices are behind a login; only Enterprise is public at ≈ £5,000/yr per language. AmE audio is limited. The sandbox's A-words-only limit means most of the ten fixture words cannot be tested without a paid plan.

providers.name: Cambridge Dictionary API
providers.description: Cambridge's learner and general dictionaries with both British and American audio, commercial access only.

providers.name: Collins Dictionary API
providers.description: Collins English dictionary data with multiple senses and British-led pronunciation audio.
providers.note: AmE audio is unclear from public docs; task-16 settles it empirically if a key is obtained.

providers.name: WordsAPI (RapidAPI)
providers.description: Definitions grouped by part of speech plus word relations (synonyms, etc.), with IPA text but no audio.

providers.name: API Ninjas Dictionary
providers.description: Minimal single-definition lookup, part of a large generic API bundle.
providers.note: One definition string with the senses numbered inline (Webster 1913-style); the adapter splits it. No audio. Returned nothing for inflected forms (flustered, circumstances) on 2026-09-27.

providers.name: Datamuse
providers.description: Fast word-finding API that can attach short definitions (md=d) and Arpabet pronunciation.
providers.note: 1–few senses. Pronunciation is Arpabet text, no audio. A key becomes required from 2027 (self-serve). Returned 200 in ~0.33 s on 2026-09-24.

providers.name: Wiktionary REST API
providers.description: Wikimedia's REST endpoint returning Wiktionary definitions by part of speech, as HTML fragments.
providers.note: Audio only sometimes. Definitions are HTML-wrapped. Returned 200 in ~1.9 s on 2026-09-24, but 404 on the idiom.

providers.name: Wiktextract / kaikki.org
providers.description: Machine-readable dump of all of Wiktionary, with senses and Wikimedia Commons audio for UK and US.
providers.note: Not a live API — bulk download only, so the harness cannot probe it.

providers.name: ECDICT
providers.description: Free offline English dictionary database (SQLite/CSV) with several senses per word and no audio.
providers.reason: Download-only data file, not an API.
